critical_missing_variables.description: Service role key for server-side Supabase operations
critical_missing_variables.impact: Database operations will fail, authentication issues

critical_missing_variables.description: Database connection URL - can use Supabase URL

immediate_actions: Set SUPABASE_KEY to your Supabase service role key
Set NEXTAUTH_URL to your Choreo development URL
validation_steps: Check that configurationStatus changes from CRITICAL to HEALTHY
Monitor memory usage and startup performance

security_notes.jwt_secret: Generate 32+ character random string for JWT signing
security_notes.nextauth_secret: Generate 32+ character random string for NextAuth.js
security_notes.supabase_keys: Never expose service role key in client-side code
security_notes.environment_isolation: Ensure development keys are separate from production
